talent4.name: Dead Man's Hand
talent4.desc:
Flip a card when landing shots with a Rifle or Marksman Rifle. 

After <color name="orange">5</color> cards are flipped, the damage of your next shot is amplified by <color name="orange">75%</color>. More shots are enhanced the better the hand revealed.

Four of a Kind: <color name="orange">4</color> shots.

Full House: <color name="orange">3</color> shots.

Aces and Eights: <color name="orange">2</color> shots.

Flip an additional card on <color name="orange">headshots</color>.

backpackTalent.name: Ace in the Sleeve
backpackTalent.desc: Amps 1 extra shot by 30%.

chestTalent.name: No Limit
chestTalent.desc: Increases Dead Man's Hand damage bonus from <color name="orange">75%</color> to <color name="orange">100%</color>.

talent4.name: Stoic
talent4.desc: STOIC: Get 3% dmg resistance per enemy targeting you. Multiplied by 1.X, X = team size.

backpackTalent.name: Polytheylene Plating
backpackTalent.desc: Increases Stoic dmg Resistance to 4%.

chestTalent.name: Deceit
chestTalent.desc: Enemies targeting your Decoy also count towards the Stoic dmg Resistance Bonus.

talent4.name: On Point
talent4.desc:
<color name="orange">Hitting</color> a shot with a <color name="orange">Rifle or MMR</color> grants a stack. Max stack is equal to the weapon's <color name="orange">Magazine Size</color>. <color name="orange">Reloading</color> will grant <color name="orange">+2% Weapon Handling</color> and <color name="orange">+4% Weapon Damage</color> per stack, for <color name="orange">20s</color>.
No stacks are acquired while the bonuses are active. The timer running out will <color name="orange">refill</color> your magazine.
Switching weapons while the bonuses are active will stop the effect and refill your magazine. Switching weapons while the bonuses are not active will remove all stacks and refill your magazine.

backpackTalent.name: Point of Honor
backpackTalent.desc: Increase <color name="orange">On Point</color> Weapon Damage bonus from <color name="orange">2%</color> to <color name="orange">9%</color>.

chestTalent.name: Point of No Return
chestTalent.desc: Increase <color name="orange">On Point</color> bonuses timer from <color name="orange">10s</color> to <color name="orange">40s</color>.

talent4.name: Charging
talent4.desc: CHARGING - Reduce incoming skill damage per second out of cover, up to 50%. CHARGED: At max (10s), become immune to movement CC, and share skill DR and all Hazard Protection with all allies. Lasts 10 seconds.

backpackTalent.name: Safe Charging
backpackTalent.desc: Charging gives 10% protection per second.

chestTalent.name: Overcharging
chestTalent.desc: Increases Charging max incoming dmg protection to 70%.

talent4.name: Camaraderie
talent4.desc:
Shooting an enemy marks them for <color name="orange">10s</color>.
When a marked enemy dies, receive one stack of <color name="orange">3% Weapon Damage</color> for each Ally or Skill that has contributed to killing that enemy.

Max stacks is <color name="orange">35</color>. Stacks decay every <color name="orange">10s</color>.
Maximum amount of marks that can be placed is <color name="orange">4</color>.

backpackTalent.name: One for All
backpackTalent.desc: Increase the Weapon Damage bonus per stack from <color name="orange">3%</color> to <color name="orange">6%</color>.

chestTalent.name: All for One
chestTalent.desc: Increases the number of enemies that can be marked from 2 to 4.

talent4.name: Core Exercise
talent4.desc: For each Core on your gear pieces, receive 40% of the other two Cores bonuses. Skill Tiers count as 15% Skill Efficiency when these bonuses are applied. All pieces except the Backpack feature random Cores.

backpackTalent.name: Outer Core
backpackTalent.desc: Does not change Core Exercise directly. This Backpack features three Core Attributes.

chestTalent.name: Inner Core
chestTalent.desc: Increases the percentage of bonuses received from other Cores.

talent4.name: Indirect Transmission
talent4.desc: INDIRECT TRANSMISSION: Status effects spread on kill to ALL enemies within 10m, and refresh 50% of their duration.

backpackTalent.name: Symptom Aggravator
backpackTalent.desc: Amplifies all dmg you deal to status affected targets by 30%.

chestTalent.name: Proliferation
chestTalent.desc: Increases Indirect Transmission range from 10m to 15m and refresh percentage from 50% to 75%.

talent4.name: Spontaneous Combustion
talent4.desc:
Every Status Effect you apply has a <color name="orange">40%</color> chance of also applying <color name="orange">Burn</color> to the enemy.

If the Status Effect initially applied was Burn, the enemy will receive <color name="orange">+25% Burn Damage</color> for the duration of the Burn.

backpackTalent.name: White Hot
backpackTalent.desc: Increase the Duration of the Burn Damage debuff of <color name="orange">Spontaneous Combustion</color> by <color name="orange">+50%</color>.

chestTalent.name: Flashpoint
chestTalent.desc: Increase the chance of applying Burn of <color name="orange">Spontaneous Combustion</color> to <color name="orange">20%</color>.

talent4.name: Makeshift Repairs
talent4.desc: MAKESHIFT REPAIRS: Whenever you or your shield take damage, 20% of that amount is repaired to both over 15s.

backpackTalent.name: Improved Materials
backpackTalent.desc: Increases Makeshift Repairs from 20% to 30%.

chestTalent.name: Process Refinery
chestTalent.desc: Increases Makeshift Repairs speed from 15s to 10s.

talent4.name: Ground Control
talent4.desc: GROUND CONTROL: At full armor, entire team gains 15% skill dmg and 15% weapon dmg. 60% of ally healing is matched.

backpackTalent.name: Strategic Combat Support
backpackTalent.desc: Increases Ground Control proximity repair from 60% to 120%.

chestTalent.name: Tactical Superiority
chestTalent.desc: Increases Ground Control dmg bonus from +15% to +25%.

talent4.name: Feedback Loop
talent4.desc: FEEDBACK LOOP: Using or canceling a skill refunds 30s skill cooldown to your other skill. Can occur once per 20s.

backpackTalent.name: Short Circuit
backpackTalent.desc: Increases Feedback Loop skill dmg and repair bonus from +10% to +25%.

chestTalent.name: Positive Reinforcement
chestTalent.desc: Decreases Feedback Loop cooldown from 20s to 10s.

talent4.name: Heartstopper
talent4.desc: HEARTSTOPPER: Headshots pulse for 5s. Shots against pulsed enemies grant 1% bonus armor and 1% Wep dmg, up to 50. Decays 2 per second

backpackTalent.name: Cold
backpackTalent.desc: Increases total bonus armor gained per stack of Heartbreaker from 1% to 2%.

chestTalent.name: Max BPM
chestTalent.desc: Increases max stacks for Heartstopper from 50 to 100.

talent4.name: Headache
talent4.desc:
First Headshot with a MR will increase next headshot by 20%, second consecutive headshot with a MR will give +10% armor (if at full armor it will give bonus armor max +50% of current armor value), third consecutive headshot will refill magazine.

From the 4th headshot forward agents will get all 3 bonuses for each consecutive headshot kill. Missing a headshot will reset the cycle.

backpackTalent.name: Blessed
backpackTalent.desc: Agents can miss a headshot before resetting the cycle.

chestTalent.name: Daring
chestTalent.desc: Increases bonus Armor from 50% to 100%.

talent4.name: Apex Predator
talent4.desc: APEX PREDATOR: Nearby enemies (15m) are debuffed by 20%. Killing these debuffed enemies with a weapon disorients within 5m, and amps weapon dmg by 5%, up to 25%, for 10s.

backpackTalent.name: Overwhelming Force
backpackTalent.desc: Increases the radius of disorient on Apex Predator kills from 5m to 10m.

chestTalent.name: Endless Hunger
chestTalent.desc: Increases the duration of Apex Predator stacks from 10s to 30s.

talent4.name: Huddle
talent4.desc: Receive +1 Skill Tier for each ally Agent within range of your Hive or Smart Cover. At Skill Tier 6, having an ally in range for 4s grants Overcharge for 15s (40s cooldown). Mortars/enemy Skills entering the range are destroyed (10s cooldown, 20% faster per ally in range).

backpackTalent.name: Smart Cooperation
backpackTalent.desc: Decreases the Mortar/Skill destruction cooldown from 10s to 1s.

chestTalent.name: Hivemind
chestTalent.desc: Decreases the Overcharge cooldown from 40s to 25s.

talent4.name: Crowd Control
talent4.desc:
Critical hits mark enemies for <color name="orange">20s</color>, up to <color name="orange">3</color> marks total.

When you critically hit a marked enemy, all other marked enemies take <color name="orange">60%</color> of the damage dealt.

Whenever a marked enemy dies, gain <color name="orange">+10%</color> critical hit damage, stacking up to <color name="orange">10</color> times, until combat ends.

backpackTalent.name: Target Rich Environment
backpackTalent.desc: Increases Hostile Negotiations dmg to additional marked enemies from 60% to 100%.

chestTalent.name: Critical Measures
chestTalent.desc: Increases Hostile Negotiations mark count from 3 to 5.

talent4.name: Rules of Engagement
talent4.desc:
Shooting a status affected enemy will apply a mark.

Killing a marked enemy grants a full clip of <color name="orange">Hollow-Point Ammo</color> for your active weapon, and half a clip of the agent's active weapon to the rest of the party

Mark lasts for <color name="orange">10</color> seconds.

<color name="orange">Hollow-Point Ammo</color> amplifies <color name="orange">weapon damage</color> by <color name="orange">40%</color> and applies <color name="orange">bleed</color> on hit.

backpackTalent.name: Trauma Specialist
backpackTalent.desc: Increases the duration of your bleed status effects by 50% and all bleed dmg done by 100%.

chestTalent.name: Parabellum Rounds
chestTalent.desc:
Increases <color name="orange">Hollow-Point Ammo</color> weapon damage amplification to <color name="orange">60%</color>.

This bonus does not apply to party members.

talent4.name: Ortiz Incinerator Turret Prototype
talent4.desc:
The Incinerator Turret spins <color name="orange">360°</color>.
The Incinerator Turret <color name="orange">explodes when disabled</color>.

backpackTalent.name: Heatstroke
backpackTalent.desc:
<color name="orange">+15% Weapon Damage</color> to enemies set on fire by the <color name="orange">Ortiz Incinerator Turret Prototype</color>.

<color name="orange">+25% Ortiz Incinerator Turret Prototype Range</color>

chestTalent.name: Chain Combustion
chestTalent.desc: Enemies set ablaze by the <color name="orange">Ortiz Incinerator Turret Prototype ignite</color>  other enemies within <color name="orange">1m</color>.

talent4.name: Ortiz Rapid Application Nanite Prototype
talent4.desc: Healing Skills Duration and Range are decreased by 10%, but their Healing Efficiency is increased by 90%. Healing an Ally with a Skill grants them 30% Hazard Protection for 10s (10s cooldown per ally).

backpackTalent.name: Improved Dampeners
backpackTalent.desc: Decreases the Duration/Range reduction of Ortiz Rapid Application Nanite Prototype from 10% to 35%.

chestTalent.name: Overcharged Nanites
chestTalent.desc: Increases the Healing Efficiency bonus of Ortiz Rapid Application Nanite Prototype from 90% to 150%.

talent4.name: Return to Sender
talent4.desc: Receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills. Your allies receive repairs of 20% of the damage dealt by your Skills.

backpackTalent.name: Over-engineered
backpackTalent.desc: While at full Armor, repairs received from Return to Sender grant Bonus Armor, up to 80% of your Total Armor. Does not apply to allies.

chestTalent.name: Incresed Interest [sic - in-game typo]
chestTalent.desc: Increases the repairs granted by Return to Sender from 10% to 25% for yourself, and from 20% to 35% for allies.

talent4.name: Tend and Befriend
talent4.desc: TEND AND BEFRIEND: Interacting with deployed skills grants the skill 25% damage for 10s. Cannot be refreshed. Interactions include: Using/Deploying the Skill, changing the Skills target, Healing the Skill.

backpackTalent.name: Complete Uptime
backpackTalent.desc: Canceling your skills will reset their cooldown.

chestTalent.name: Best Buds
chestTalent.desc: Increase the dmg buff from 25% to 50%.

talent4.name: Striker's Gamble
talent4.desc: STRIKERS GAMBLE: Weapon hits increase damage, up to 100 stacks (65%). [0-50]: 1 stack decay per second. [51-100]: 2 stack decay per second.

backpackTalent.name: Risk Management
backpackTalent.desc: Increases total weapon dmg gained per stack of Striker’s Gamble from 0.65% to 1%.

chestTalent.name: Press the Advantage
chestTalent.desc: Max stacks increased to 200. Lose 3 stacks per second between 100 and 200.

talent4.name: Hackstep Protocol
talent4.desc: HACKSTEP PROTOCOL: Replaces armor kits with an instant, infinite-use ability on a 20s cooldown, that repairs 20% armor, grants 50% bonus armor and hides your nameplate for 5s. Increases total weapon damage by 1% per 5% bonus armor gained, up to 20%.

backpackTalent.name: Multithreaded Execution
backpackTalent.desc: Increases Hackstep Protocol bonus armor from 50% to 100%.

chestTalent.name: Compiler Optimization
chestTalent.desc: Decreases Hackstep Protocol cooldown from 20s to 15s.

talent4.name: Aggressive Recon
talent4.desc: AGGRESSIVE RECON: Signature Weapon kills give +15% Signature Weapon Damage for 10s and +25% Reload Speed for the next reload of the weapon, not stacking. Gain Signature Weapon Ammo every 60s.

backpackTalent.name: Specialized Destruction
backpackTalent.desc: +50% Weapon dmg for 15s after fully depleting the Signature Weapon of ammo. Doubles the amount of ammo generated by Aggressive Recon.

chestTalent.name: Crossbow Expert
chestTalent.desc: Increase Aggressive Recon Signature Weapon dmg bonus from 15% to 30%. Every 3rd Signature Weapon kill generates Signature Weapon ammo.

talent4.name: Throttle Control
talent4.desc:
Shooting builds stacks to a max of 50. Each stack provides +0.5% Weapon Handling and +5% Critical Hit Damage.
Lose 6 stacks per second while not shooting. No stacks are lost if an enemy is Suppressed.

backpackTalent.name: Snowball
backpackTalent.desc: Increase the Critical Hit Damage received per stack from 5% to 8%.

chestTalent.name: Sustainability
chestTalent.desc: Increases the maximum number of stacks from 50 to 75.

talent4.name: <color name="red">Red</color>, <color name="white">White</color> and <color name="blue">Blue</color>
talent4.desc:
Enemies you shoot receive a stacking debuff of <color name="red">Red</color>/<color name="white">White</color>/<color name="blue">Blue</color>, cycling every <color name="orange">2s</color>.

<color name="red">Red:</color> Amplifies the enemy's damage taken by <color name="orange">15%</color>.

<color name="white">White:</color> Hitting the enemy restores you and your allies' armor by <color name="orange">2%</color> (1s cooldown).

<color name="blue">Blue:</color> Decreases the enemy's damage dealt by <color name="orange">10%</color>.

Full Flag: Enemies that die while under the effect of all 3 debuffs create a <color name="orange">5m</color> explosion, dealing damage equal to their total health and armor. (Explosion strength reduced on Named enemy deaths)

backpackTalent.name: Patriotic Boost
backpackTalent.desc:
Increases "<color name="red">Red</color>, <color name="white">White</color> and <color name="blue">Blue</color>" debuff strength.

<color name="red">Red</color>: <color name="orange">15%</color> to <color name="orange">30%</color>
<color name="white">White</color>: <color name="orange">2%</color> to <color name="orange">5%</color>
<color name="blue">Blue</color>: <color name="orange">10%</color> to <color name="orange">20%</color>

chestTalent.name: Waving the Flag
chestTalent.desc: Increases "<color name="red">Red</color>, <color name="white">White</color> and <color name="blue">Blue</color>" rotation speed to <color name="orange">1s</color>.

talent4.name: From the Shadows
talent4.desc: FROM THE SHADOWS: While in cover, gain crit damage and rpm over 5s, up to 50%/15%, which applies out of cover and decays slowly. While out of cover and in combat, gain future armor regen over 5s, up to 40%. Stacks consume at the same rate in cover, repairing armor.

backpackTalent.name: Into the Light
backpackTalent.desc: Doubles the armor regen buff

chestTalent.name: From the Shadows
chestTalent.desc: Doubles the crit dmg and rpm buff

talent4.name: Symphony
talent4.desc: Killing an enemy beyond 25m grants +40% Weapon Damage to Shotguns/SMGs/Pistols, +20% to ARs/LMGs, and +25% Bonus Armor for 15s. Killing an enemy within 25m grants +40% Weapon Damage to MMRs/Rifles, +20% to ARs/LMGs, and +30% Headshot Damage for 15s. Alternating kills between ranges builds stacks; at 4 stacks, bonuses double and trigger together.

backpackTalent.name: Accelerando
backpackTalent.desc: Decreases the stacks needed to proc Symphonys double buff from 4 to 3.

chestTalent.name: Fortissimo
chestTalent.desc: Doubles the Weapon Damage bonus of Symphony.
